chunks.content: Binary search locates a target in a sorted array by repeatedly halving the search interval. 二分查找要求数据有序。
Dynamic programming solves overlapping subproblems and stores reusable states. 动态规划通常包含状态定义和转移方程。
A memory leak happens when malloc allocated memory is no longer reachable but was never released with free.
Breadth first search uses a queue to visit graph nodes level by level. 广度优先遍历适合求无权图最短层数。
C# async and await should avoid blocking on Task.Result because synchronization contexts can cause a deadlock.
Hash tables resolve collisions with chaining or open addressing. 哈希表需要处理散列冲突和负载因子。
SQL JOIN combines rows across tables, while GROUP BY aggregates rows before HAVING filters groups.
Dijkstra computes shortest paths with a priority queue when edge weights are non-negative.
